qs.p: 農曆七月，外師問：「為什麼大家在門口擺供桌、燒紙錢？」最好的英文解釋是？
a: It's Ghost Month. People make offerings to wandering spirits so they'll be at peace and won't cause trouble.
It's a day when the whole town burns its old paper and trash.
It's a harvest celebration, a lot like Thanksgiving.
It's a birthday party for the local temple's god.
qs.n: 中元普渡＝Ghost Festival，農曆七月叫 Ghost Month。offerings＝供品。

qs.p: 用英文解釋「清明節」。
a: Tomb Sweeping Day is when families visit their ancestors' graves, clean them, and make offerings to show respect.
Tomb Sweeping Day is when everyone cleans their whole house before spring.
Tomb Sweeping Day honors soldiers who died in wars.
Tomb Sweeping Day is a spring festival for flying kites.
qs.n: 清明節官方英文是 Tomb Sweeping Day。ancestors＝祖先。

qs.p: 用英文解釋「端午節」。
a: The Dragon Boat Festival remembers the poet Qu Yuan. People race dragon boats and eat zongzi, sticky rice wrapped in bamboo leaves.
The Dragon Boat Festival celebrates the full moon with mooncakes.
The Dragon Boat Festival is when children carry paper lanterns at night.
The Dragon Boat Festival marks the start of the Lunar New Year.
qs.n: 粽子可以說 zongzi，第一次提到時補一句 sticky rice wrapped in bamboo leaves 解釋。

qs.p: 用英文解釋台灣的「中秋節」。
a: The Mid-Autumn Festival is about family reunions under the full moon. People eat mooncakes and pomelos, and in Taiwan, lots of families have barbecues.
The Mid-Autumn Festival is when people visit graves and clean them.
The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for racing boats on the river.
The Mid-Autumn Festival is Taiwan's version of Halloween.
qs.n: 台灣特色是烤肉！pomelo＝柚子。reunion＝團圓。

qs.p: 外師在彰化街上看到鑼鼓、鞭炮、大批人潮跟著神轎走。最好的英文解釋是？
a: It's a Mazu pilgrimage. Crowds follow the statue of Mazu, the sea goddess, from temple to temple with drums and firecrackers.
It's a marathon race through the city.
It's a parade to welcome the president.
It's a fishing competition for local fishermen.
qs.n: 媽祖遶境＝Mazu pilgrimage / procession。pilgrimage 是「進香、朝聖」。

qs.p: 外師問什麼是「尾牙」。最好的英文解釋是？
a: It's a year-end banquet that companies throw to thank their employees, often with a lucky draw.
It's the last baby tooth a child loses.
It's a temple festival for dentists.
It's the family dinner on Lunar New Year's Eve.
qs.n: 尾牙＝year-end banquet；抽獎＝lucky draw / raffle。年夜飯則是 New Year's Eve family reunion dinner。

qs.p: 用英文解釋「紅包」。
a: Red envelopes hold money given as a gift at Lunar New Year, weddings, and other happy occasions. Red stands for good luck.
Red envelopes are used for paying bills at the post office.
Getting a red envelope means you are in trouble.
Red envelopes are only given at funerals.
qs.n: 喪事用的是白包。外師參加婚禮時，常需要妳提醒包紅包。

qs.p: 外師想送同事時鐘當禮物。妳要用英文說明為什麼不適合。
a: In Chinese, "giving a clock" sounds like a phrase about seeing someone off at their funeral, so it's considered bad luck.
Clocks are too expensive to give as gifts in Taiwan.
Taiwanese people don't use clocks at home.
Giving a clock means you think the person is always late.
qs.n: 送鐘＝送終，諧音禁忌。同樣不宜送的還有傘（散）、鞋。

qs.p: 外師問為什麼有些大樓沒有四樓。最好的英文解釋是？
a: The word for "four" sounds like the word for "death," so some buildings skip the fourth floor.
Four is the luckiest number, so it's saved for special guests.
The fourth floor is always reserved for the building's owner.
Taiwanese law bans buildings from having a fourth floor.
qs.n: 跟西方人解釋時，可以類比美國有些大樓沒有 13 樓。

qs.p: 用英文解釋同事為什麼都用雙手遞名片、遞文件。
a: Handing things over with both hands, like business cards or gifts, is a way to show respect.
Using both hands is a rule because the papers are heavy.
It means the person doesn't trust you with the item.
It's only done when giving things to children.
qs.n: 外師可以學起來，雙手接名片也會讓台灣同事很有好感。

qs.p: 聚餐時，外師聽到大家喊「乾杯」很緊張。妳要怎麼用英文安撫他？
a: "Gan bei" literally means "empty your glass," but it's totally fine to just take a sip if you don't want to drink much.
"Gan bei" means you must finish your drink or it's very rude.
"Gan bei" means it's time to go home.
"Gan bei" means everyone pays for their own meal.
qs.n: literally means＝字面上的意思是。take a sip＝喝一小口。

qs.p: 外師的同事生產後在「坐月子」。用英文解釋。
a: It's the month after giving birth, when mothers rest at home, eat special nourishing food, and avoid cold food and drinks.
It's a month-long vacation that mothers take before giving birth.
It's a month when new mothers go back to work early.
It's a party held for the baby's first birthday.
qs.n: 坐月子常譯 postpartum confinement，但直接描述內容，外師更容易懂。

qs.p: 外師問為什麼午餐後學生都趴在桌上。最好的英文解釋是？
a: It's nap time. Students rest at their desks for about half an hour after lunch to recharge for the afternoon.
It's a punishment for students who talked during lunch.
The students are waiting for their parents to pick them up.
The students are taking a silent test.
qs.n: recharge＝充電、恢復精神。很多外師一開始會以為學生生病了。

qs.p: 外師問為什麼學校讓學生自己打掃。最好的英文解釋是？
a: Students clean their classrooms and parts of the campus every day. It teaches responsibility and respect for shared spaces.
It's a punishment for the whole class.
Students only clean on the last day of the school year.
It's a part-time job, and students get paid for it.
qs.n: 強調「教育目的」，外師就會理解，甚至會很欣賞。

qs.p: 外師問為什麼學生、同事都叫他「Teacher Smith」或「老師」，而不是叫名字。
a: In Taiwan, calling someone "Teacher" is a sign of respect. It's like a title, the way people say "Doctor" or "Professor."
It's because nobody can remember foreign names.
"Teacher" is the title for new teachers on probation.
It means they think you're too strict.
qs.n: 類比 Doctor / Professor，外師一聽就懂。

qs.p: 用英文解釋什麼是「補習班」。
a: Cram schools are private after-school classes where many students get extra help in English, math, or test prep.
Cram schools are special schools for students who got in trouble.
Cram schools are free summer camps run by the government.
Cram schools are where teachers go for training.
qs.n: cram school 是外師都認得的說法，也有不少外師在補習班教過書。

qs.p: Thanksgiving is a big deal for us. I'd love to have the day off to have dinner with the other FETs.
a: 感恩節是美國十一月第四個星期四，家人朋友團聚吃大餐，對他們的意義就像我們的除夕。所以他希望那天能請假，跟其他外師一起吃飯。
感恩節是美國的國慶日，他要去參加升旗。
感恩節是學生要送禮物給老師的日子。
感恩節是美國的宗教節日，他要去教堂做禮拜一整天。
qs.n: 跟校長轉述時，類比「像我們的除夕」，校長馬上就能理解外師的心情。

qs.p: In the US, we call our principal by their first name.
a: 在美國很多學校，同事之間、甚至對校長都直接叫名字。這是表示平等友善，不是沒禮貌。
在美國，叫校長全名是表示對校長不滿。
在美國，學生都直接叫校長的名字。
在美國，大家都不知道校長叫什麼名字。
qs.n: first-name basis＝互相直接叫名字的關係。這題能幫校長理解，外師叫名字並沒有冒犯的意思。

qs.p: Let's do a potluck for the end-of-semester party!
a: 期末派對我們來辦「每人帶一道菜」的聚餐吧！
期末派對我們去吃火鍋吧！
期末派對由外師一個人請客！
期末派對我們來吃剩菜吧！
qs.n: potluck＝每人帶一道菜來分享的聚餐，美國學校和社區很常見。

qs.p: In the US, tipping is expected at restaurants, usually around 15 to 20 percent.
a: 在美國，餐廳通常要另外給小費，大約是消費金額的一成五到兩成。
在美國，小費已經包含在帳單裡，不用另外給。
在美國，給小費會被認為是不禮貌。
在美國，只有高級餐廳才要給小費。
qs.n: 台灣的服務費多半含在帳單裡，美國是另外給，這是外師常聊到的文化差異。

qs.p: My sister's baby shower is next month, so I'm sending a gift home.
a: 他姊姊下個月要辦迎接新生兒的派對，親友會送嬰兒用品，所以他要寄禮物回家。
他姊姊下個月要幫寶寶洗第一次澡。
他姊姊的寶寶下個月要滿月，要辦滿月酒。
他姊姊下個月要幫寶寶取名字。
qs.n: baby shower＝產前派對，在寶寶出生前舉辦。和我們的滿月酒時間點不同。

qs.p: Americans tend to need more personal space when they talk.
a: 美國人說話時，習慣跟對方保持一點距離，靠太近會讓他們不自在。
美國人說話時，需要一個人的房間。
美國人喜歡在戶外空間聊天。
美國人說話時不喜歡看著對方。
qs.n: personal space＝個人空間，指身體距離。也可以提醒同事，拍肩、摸頭不一定合適。

qs.p: Spring break back home is in March, so my family is coming to visit then.
a: 美國學校三月左右放一週春假，所以他的家人會趁那時來台灣看他。
美國三月是新學年開始，家人要來幫他慶祝。
美國三月是暑假，家人要來台灣避暑。
他三月要回美國放春假。
qs.n: spring break＝春假；back home＝在他的家鄉。注意：是家人來台灣，不是他回去。
